reasons.plausibility: It focuses on high-temperature oxidation rather than room-temperature ductility and thus doesn’t address the stated dislocation pile-up problem, making its relevance to the question doubtful.
reasons.testability: Although straightforward to measure oxidation resistance, the proposed test does not address the question’s focus on tensile ductility, so it only partially tests the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Because it does not target the original problem of improving room-temperature ductility and preventing microcracking, it is not useful for the stated research goal.
